rationale: C18 is the direct initiating directive for the same New York World's Fair project. It assigns the Secretary of Commerce to lead consideration of federal participation, requires consultation with appropriate federal agencies, and provides project financing. The child expressly responds to the resulting report, approves its recommendations, and continues the same machinery into theme development, exhibit planning, interdepartmental policy guidance, and Budget Bureau financing. This is concrete continuity in both language and administrative structure, not merely a shared topic.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I have received your report of December 15, 1960, regarding United States participation in the New York World's Fair, and I approve your recommendations.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: It is accordingly requested that the Secretary of Commerce take the lead in considering the question of Federal participation in the New York World's Fair and present to me his recommendations thereon
shared_material.explanation: The child expressly acts on the report commissioned by C18, establishing a direct drafting and administrative sequence.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I, therefore, authorize and direct the Secretary of Commerce to be in charge of theme development and planning for the United States exhibit
shared_material.parent_excerpt: It is also desirable that preliminary consideration be given to the character and scope of any such participation.
shared_material.explanation: The child's assignment of exhibit theme and planning concretizes C18's assignment concerning the character and scope of participation.

shared_material.child_excerpt: for policy guidance he should organize an appropriate interdepartmental committee
shared_material.parent_excerpt: In connection with the carrying out of the foregoing assignment, it is requested that the appropriate Federal agencies be consulted.
shared_material.explanation: Both employ interdepartmental participation under Commerce leadership; the child formalizes the consultation structure as a committee.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Director of the Bureau of the Budget will assist you in making the necessary arrangements for financing this activity.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Expenditures arising in connection with the above shall be paid from the appropriation appearing under the heading "Special Projects"
shared_material.explanation: Both include specific financing machinery for the same federal participation project.
